summary: Registry-only record: a Cariboo tower whose wooden structure was replaced with steel. No second source found, so the story is thin.

facts.design: Steel tower that replaced a wooden tower (registry note)

evidence.supports: Registry places the lookout in Cariboo D, Cariboo, BC
Wooden tower replaced with a steel tower
evidence.quote: The wooden tower was replaced with a steel tower.

notes_for_editor: Only the firelookout.ca registry entry describes this lookout, so the story is far below the usual length and should be held or published only as a stub. Do not merge it with the Jesmond Fire Lookout: the registry puts Bull at 52.23776, -122.16028, while Wikipedia gives the Jesmond community as 51.25 N, 121.95 W, and a campingrvbc article places the Jesmond lookout near Big Bar Lake. A Facebook group post in BC Forest Fire Lookouts reports that the Jesmond Lookout was lost to fire, but its body text was not retrievable, so it is not cited; check that claim separately. Searches surfaced Bull Mountain near Williams Lake and a 2011 or 2012 BC Forest History Newsletter article by John Parminter on BC lookouts, but neither was confirmed as the Bull site. Leads to check: BC Forest Service lookout lists and the Forest History Association of BC. No Canadian register beyond firelookout.ca was checked.
